name: Large Trader AI
description: Large Trader AI is a web-based conversational assistant for financial-market research. Users ask questions in natural language to explore stocks, US options, forex, crypto and companies. The interface supports researching markets and trading ideas through a question-and-answer workflow rather than requiring users to navigate separate reports. It is intended for people who want to explore and understand financial-market information. Large Trader AI uses a freemium pricing model. Its AI-generated responses are informational and are not investment advice or a recommendation to transact.
